# LokalBot

> Local AI meeting notes, screen recall, dictation, autocomplete, and read-only MCP. LokalBot is a free, open-source (GPLv3) app for macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows and Linux (native Rust + GPUI alpha), plus iOS and Android companion apps, that records meetings without a bot, transcribes and summarizes them on-device using Apache-2.0 fine-tuned models, and searches your meetings and opt-in screen memory. No account, no analytics, no hosted AI backend. Full benchmark tables, comparisons, and FAQs in one file: https://www.lokalbot.com/llms-full.txt

Key facts (v0.14.0, updated 2026-11-26):

- Platforms: macOS 15.0 or later on Apple Silicon (M1 or later). In alpha: Windows 10 or 11 (x64) and Linux (x86_64, glibc 2.39 or later), a native Rust + GPUI app reading the exact same SQLite library format. Companion apps are on the App Store for iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 18+, https://apps.apple.com/app/id6836773709) and on Google Play for Android (Android 10+, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=me.dotenv.lokalbot.companion). No Intel Mac or web version.
- Price and license: free, GNU GPL v3 (Autocomplete files ported from Cotabby stay under AGPLv3). Source: https://github.com/stevyhacker/LokalBot (124 GitHub stars as of November 26, 2026).
- Install: from https://github.com/stevyhacker/lokalbot/releases/latest download `LokalBot-<version>-macos-arm64.dmg` (or run `brew install --cask stevyhacker/tap/lokalbot`) on Mac, `LokalBot-<version>-windows-x86_64-setup.exe` (per-user, no admin rights) or portable `.zip` on Windows (not code-signed yet), or `.deb`, `.rpm`, Arch `.pkg.tar.zst`, or `.tar.gz` (`./install.sh`) on Linux. The `.deb` and Fedora `.rpm` register `pkg.lokalbot.com` for `apt` / `dnf` upgrades.
- Phones and tablets: the iOS and Android apps pair by QR code with LokalBot on Mac, Windows, or Linux (`Settings > Phones & tablets`, off by default). They keep an end-to-end encrypted copy of shared meetings, actions, Timeline, Day Digests, people, and projects, sync directly over local Wi-Fi or Tailscale with no LokalBot server, search offline, record in-person meetings for the computer to transcribe, and send Ask questions to the computer.
- Meetings: records the microphone and meeting app audio on two synchronized local tracks without joining the call (on Windows and Linux, isolated per app where supported, otherwise system output). Detects Zoom, Teams, Meet, Slack, FaceTime, Discord, Webex, Tencent Meeting, Feishu, DingTalk, Yandex Telemost, MTS Link, eXpress, plus custom native call apps and opt-in browser sites. Fresh installs ask via notification before recording.
- Local v0.14.0 Apache-2.0 fine-tuned default models:
  - Think (notes, actions, Personal Context memory, Ask): `Qwen3.5 4B (LokalBot v4)` (`2.74 GB` Q4_K_M, https://huggingface.co/stevyhacker/Qwen3.5-4B-LokalBot-GGUF, `118/120` Memory120, `-60.6%` Blind21 Swift validator rejections, `1.78x` faster `13.64 s` latency).
  - Transcription (Mac default): `Qwen3-ASR 1.7B (LokalBot v3)` (`2.52 GB` GGUF Q8_0 + fine-tuned top-4 `audio_tower` `mmproj`, https://huggingface.co/stevyhacker/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-LokalBot-GGUF, `9.79%` AMI ihm WER, `12.81%` code-switch WER vs `37.12%` stock, `0` dictation silence hallucinations, `100%` custom vocab recall).
  - Transcription (compact / fallback): `Qwen3-ASR 0.6B (LokalBot v1)` (`1.02 GB` Q8_0, https://huggingface.co/stevyhacker/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B-LokalBot-GGUF, `52.7x` RT on M4 Max), plus Parakeet, IBM Granite Speech (Mac), SenseVoice/GigaAM (Windows/Linux), and Whisper large-v3 turbo.
  - Autocomplete (Cotyping): `Gemma 4 E2B (LokalBot v4)` (`3.85 GB` i1-Q6_K, https://huggingface.co/stevyhacker/Gemma-4-E2B-LokalBot-GGUF, `56/56` visible-window and saved-memory grounding, `80.0%` email precision, `20.2 ms` boundary / `56 ms` typing median on M4 Max), plus lightweight `LFM2.5 1.2B` (`0.73 GB`).
  - Search & Diarization: `EmbeddingGemma 2` (`0.31 GB` Q8_0, `39 ms` / `50 MB` RAM on QMSum) + SQLite FTS5, and `Nemotron 3` Core ML (`0.20 GB`, `14.56%` DER on Mac; pyannote + TitaNet on Windows/Linux). Previous stock checkpoints remain selectable in `Settings > Models`.
- Optional remote backends: Ollama, OpenAI-compatible servers, Anthropic Messages API, and the user's own ChatGPT, Claude, Antigravity (`agy`), or Gemini (`gemini`) plans on every platform, plus Apple Intelligence on Mac (macOS 26+). Every non-local server or plan requires explicit per-origin approval.
- Imports & migration: built-in read-only importers for Granola, Otter, Fireflies, Fathom, Screenpipe, Zoom, Voice Memos, MacWhisper, and Wispr Flow (`flow.sqlite` meetings and personal dictionary, skipping snippets and deleted entries), plus offline browser converter at https://www.lokalbot.com/migrate.
- Languages: Qwen3-ASR transcribes 52 languages and dialects; notes follow the detected meeting language; UI translated into 24 languages.
- Workday memory & coding agents: day tracking starts with app names and window titles only; screen text and AES-GCM encrypted screenshots are opt-in (14-day default auto-delete). Includes hold-to-talk dictation, waveform zoom/trim/split (Mac), Obsidian/Logseq automatic Markdown export, open-source Obsidian plugin (https://github.com/stevyhacker/obsidian-lokalbot), Raycast extension (https://www.raycast.com/stevan_bogosavljevic/lokalbot), read-only stdio CLI/MCP (`lokalbot-cli mcp`) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity, local coding-agent session tracking (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, T3 Code), and `lokalbot-cli reprocess`.
- Mainland China: supports Tencent Meeting, VooV Meeting, Feishu, Lark, DingTalk, WeCom, CJK substring search, and HF-Mirror / ModelScope downloads (`Settings > Models`).
- Not supported: cloud syncing between desktop computers.

## Product & Browser Tools

- [LokalBot home](https://www.lokalbot.com/): features, interactive demo, and FAQ
- [Agent Wrapped](https://www.lokalbot.com/wrapped): local, zero-upload year in review for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Antigravity, and Gemini CLI (`npx lokalbot`)
- [Meeting Migrator](https://www.lokalbot.com/migrate): offline, zero-upload browser converter turning Granola, Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Zoom, Teams, Screenpipe, Krisp, Tactiq, and Wispr Flow exports into Obsidian Markdown
- [Local AI Hardware & RAM Calculator](https://www.lokalbot.com/hardware): interactive zero-upload estimator for Apple Silicon Macs, Windows, and Linux checking disk, resident RAM, KV-cache, GPU offload, and LokalBot's 50% memory residency cap
- [SaaS AI Subscription & Cloud Audio Calculator](https://www.lokalbot.com/calculator): calculate 1-year and 3-year meeting/dictation SaaS costs and uploaded audio hours vs $0 and 0 bytes on-device
- [About LokalBot](https://www.lokalbot.com/about): fact sheet, what it does and does not do
- [System requirements](https://www.lokalbot.com/system-requirements): Mac, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android requirements and feature parity
- [Local Desktop AI Leaderboard](https://www.lokalbot.com/benchmarks): reproducible benchmarks across 7 roles and 17 suites with JSON at [benchmarks.json](https://www.lokalbot.com/benchmarks.json)
- [Privacy policy](https://www.lokalbot.com/privacy): complete data and network contract

## Blog

- [LokalBot blog](https://www.lokalbot.com/blog): releases, local model benchmarks, and build notes ([Atom feed](https://www.lokalbot.com/blog/feed.xml))
- [Fine-Tuning Four Small Local Models Against a Swift Validator Loop](https://www.lokalbot.com/blog/fine-tuning-four-local-models-swift-validator): how we trained Qwen3.5 4B v4, Qwen3-ASR 1.7B v3 / 0.6B v1, and Gemma 4 E2B v4 on open datasets, including Blind21 recall tradeoffs and the Astra weight-space pilot
- [39 ms and 50 MB vs. 255 ms and 1 GB: QMSum local retrieval benchmark](https://www.lokalbot.com/blog/gbrain-vs-lokalbot-memory-benchmark): LokalBot SQLite FTS5 + EmbeddingGemma 2 vs GBrain across 232 public meetings and 1,576 questions
- [Local speech-to-text vs. cloud APIs on real meetings](https://www.lokalbot.com/blog/local-stt-vs-cloud-apis): Qwen3-ASR 1.7B and Parakeet local vs Gemini, GPT-4o Transcribe, and Qwen-Audio cloud APIs
- [56 ms local system-wide autocomplete benchmark](https://www.lokalbot.com/blog/local-autocomplete-56ms-benchmark): headless keystroke benchmark of Gemma 4 E2B vs LFM2.5 1.2B across 788 word positions
- [Recall vs. restraint](https://www.lokalbot.com/blog/recall-vs-restraint-memory-benchmark): 120-case benchmark of local models deciding what to save as a memory and what to skip
- [LokalBot is on Windows and Linux, in alpha](https://www.lokalbot.com/blog/windows-and-linux-alpha): native Rust + GPUI port details and install instructions
- [How the Windows and Linux port was built](https://www.lokalbot.com/blog/porting-to-windows-and-linux-with-agents): specs first, automated verification, and link to the full write-up

## Guides

- [Best local and open-source AI meeting note takers (2026)](https://www.lokalbot.com/best-local-ai-meeting-notes): LokalBot, Meetily, Anarlog, OpenWhispr, MacWhisper, and Screenpipe compared on WER, RAM, MCP, and licenses
- [The best open-source AI assistants you can run locally](https://www.lokalbot.com/best-open-source-ai-assistants): Ollama, LM Studio, Jan, AnythingLLM, Open WebUI, and LokalBot compared
- [Meeting notes MCP for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity](https://www.lokalbot.com/claude-code-codex-meeting-notes): read-only local stdio MCP setup, tool list, and privacy boundary
- [LokalBot plugins for Claude Code and Codex](https://www.lokalbot.com/claude-code-codex-plugins): catch-up brief, recall with citations, and guided setup skills
- [Granola and Otter alternatives for Linux and Windows](https://www.lokalbot.com/granola-otter-alternatives-linux-windows): per-app breakdown of bot-free local note takers for Linux and Windows
- [Best Rewind AI and Limitless Mac alternatives after the Meta shutdown](https://www.lokalbot.com/rewind-limitless-mac-alternatives): active local screen recall and meeting memory options on macOS
- [An open-source Windows Recall alternative that is opt-in and encrypted](https://www.lokalbot.com/open-source-windows-recall-alternative): searchable screen and meeting memory on any Windows 10/11 x64 PC without Copilot+ NPU lock-in
- [GDPR AI meeting notes with zero cloud subprocessors](https://www.lokalbot.com/gdpr-local-ai-meeting-notes): on-device vs EU cloud vs US cloud compliance architecture and DPO verification checklist
- [Local AI meeting notes on Linux](https://www.lokalbot.com/local-ai-meeting-notes-linux): X11/Wayland support, apt/dnf/pacman install, Vulkan/CUDA
- [Local AI meeting notes on Windows](https://www.lokalbot.com/local-ai-meeting-notes-windows): bot-free Teams, Zoom, and Meet capture, per-user install, Vulkan/CUDA
- [Local AI meeting notes on your Mac](https://www.lokalbot.com/local-ai-meeting-notes-mac): bot-free two-track capture, on-device transcription, and setup
- [Offline meeting transcription on Mac](https://www.lokalbot.com/offline-meeting-transcription-mac): local speech models, timestamps, and offline verification
- [Record both sides of a Mac meeting without a bot](https://www.lokalbot.com/record-both-sides-mac-meeting-without-bot): microphone plus meeting-app audio as synchronized tracks
- [Local transcription models for Mac](https://www.lokalbot.com/local-transcription-models-mac): Qwen3-ASR, Parakeet, Granite Speech, and Whisper compared
- [Open-source AI meeting notes: what to verify](https://www.lokalbot.com/open-source-ai-meeting-notes): license, local processing, network boundaries, storage, and builds
- [My company blocks AI notetaker bots. What can I use?](https://www.lokalbot.com/ai-notetaker-bots-blocked-at-work): local capture tradeoffs and an IT security review checklist
- [Can a bot-free meeting recorder tell who said what?](https://www.lokalbot.com/bot-free-meeting-recorder-speaker-labels): speaker separation without a bot and measured Nemotron 3 accuracy
- [How do I get meeting transcripts into Obsidian as Markdown?](https://www.lokalbot.com/meeting-transcripts-obsidian-markdown): automatic per-meeting notes, daily notes, CLI scripts, and the Obsidian plugin
